Treasure Map

Treasures and easter eggs are hidden all over the platform: the homepage, the Guide, every Trade Skills room, the stations, the Atlas, the arcade and the racer, Bay World, the Deep, the Regatta and Fairway Park. Each one teaches something real, taken word for word from the platform's own union registry, standards registry, station notes or tool list. This map shows how many you have found in each place. It never shows where an unfound one is.

Earlier eggs

The older egg layers keep their own ledgers; this map only counts them: the golden hard hats and field notes in the stations, Bay World's egg field notes, the Deep's lanterns, Sierra Summit's field notes and Redwood Reach's field tins.

Your treasures are saved to your own profile: signed in, this device, or the demo tab (the demo keeps nothing once the tab closes). Some treasures stay locked until you have passed a station; when you find a locked one, it tells you which station to pass.

Choose a world to find more. Still lost? The Guide button in the corner answers questions about every world and programme.
